name: Swein Forkbeard
contribution: King of Denmark from c. 986 and briefly King of England from December 1013.
legacy: This person extended Danish control east of Øresund into Skane in what is now southern Sweden.

checks.lead: Swein Forkbeard (died 3 February 1014) was King of Denmark from c. 986 and briefly King of England from December 1013. He was also overlord of Norway c. 986 – c. 994 and from c. 1000. He married the sister of Boleslaus, ruler of Poland, and had three known children by her: King Harald II of Denmark, King Cnut of England, and Estrid, the mother of the Danish king Sweyn Estridsson. Swein also had a daughter, Gytha, by an earlier liaison.
